items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Harry James said to Bobby Starr, 'I got my lesson.' Bobby Starr used to play some solo, and that number was unbelievable.

ctx.x: "Big John Special." That tune was written by Horace Henderson. And I opened my second set (inaudible). We're hoping for the same note. The house came down. And I remember, when we finish that first number, Goodman's band didn't even come out -- the bandstand. And Harry James said to Bobby Starr, "I got my lesson." Bobby Starr used to play some solo, and that number was unbelievable.

So from then on -- that night, the whole night there was (inaudible) music. And I remember when they'd walk in, Tommy Dorsey said to -- I think it was Wood Osman (phonetic), I bet you son of a gun I'm going to solo Chick Webb and Benny Goodman to pieces. I said, well, just put your money on the barrel.
